name: Colin T. Moran
current_role: Co-founder and Managing Partner, Abdiel Capital (Abdiel Capital Advisors, LP), New York
profile: Hedge fund manager who co-founded Abdiel Capital with Geoffrey Gentile in 2006 after stints at Goldman Sachs and as a partner at Chieftain Capital. Abdiel is a concentrated, long-term investor and long-time 10%+ holder of low-code software firm Appian (APPN); in 2025 it also took a ~12% stake in Rise Gold (RYES), which is reviving California's Idaho-Maryland gold mine.
interesting_fact: Abdiel has reported as a 10%+ owner of Appian for years, filing more than 40 amendments to its Schedule 13D on the company.
deep_cut_fact: Before running money he trained as a historian and lawyer: a summa cum laude B.A. in History and Economics from Duke, an MSt in Modern History from Oxford, and a law degree from Stanford Law School (Order of the Coif).
notes: Low-profile investor; no published personal or firm contact email found. Rise Gold stake per Form 3 (Oct 2025): https://www.secform4.com/filings/1424864/0001193125-25-261127.htm. Education details from MarketScreener aggregator; worth double-checking.
